## Idea

What would you like the site to do?

## Why

What problem does it solve for listeners or for the hosts?

## Simplicity check

The brief for this site is **faster, but also super smooth and simple to use.**

- [ ] One-thumb operation on a phone
- [ ] Adds no new visible button unless one is removed
- [ ] Needs no settings screen and no explanation (if it needs explaining, it's cut)
- [ ] Stays inside the performance budgets (payload ≤ 500 KB; time-to-audio clips < 1.5s, episodes < 2s, live < 3s)

## Not on the table

Parked by Alex — don't propose these without his say: **Phase 2 archive page, mini-player, Up Next auto-advance.** Also out: fake waveform, title ticker, discovery modal, framework rewrite.
